label: F1RL passive 1-link LC fibre TAP
description: Passive 1-link optical TAP, 2 network LC + 2 monitor LC, unpowered.
notes: Datasheet v4.3: '1 network link / 1 monitor link', LC connectors, passive/unpowered, split ratios 50/50 (3.8 dB MM 50 um), 60/40, 70/30, 80/20. Rate ladder sold: MM 62.5 um 1 Gbps, OM4 1-100 Gbps, SM 1-400 Gbps. Modelled at the catalogue's 1G/10G SFP+ class; the tap's LC/UPC adapters are caged as SFP+ because simulator links run port-to-port and must match cage classes.

label: F4L passive 4-link LC fibre TAP
description: Passive 4-link optical TAP, 8 network LC + 8 monitor LC, unpowered.
notes: Datasheet v4.3: '4 network links / 4 monitor links', 113 x 88 x 30 mm, 260 g, three per 1U rack frame (ARF-1U). Sixteen LC adapters total, hence sixteen ports. Same rate ladder and same SFP+ caging as the F1RL.

label: C1R-10G passive 10GBASE-T copper TAP
description: Inline 10M/100M/1G/10GBASE-T copper TAP, 2 RJ45 network + 2 SFP+ monitor, PoE passthrough.
notes: Datasheet v3.7: '2 x RJ45 8 pins, 2 x SFP+', 770 g, redundant 12 VDC, latency 2.3 us at 10G, monitor side is a data diode, LFP supported, 802.3af and VoIP compliant with PoE passthrough. Powered for PHY/LFP only - no IP address, no management. 10 Mbit/s omitted from speedCaps deliberately.

label: Network Critical passive LC fibre TAP (family)
description: Passive LC fibre TAP family, 1G/10G, up to 16 taps in 1RU.
notes: OPEN, not catalogued: the vendor's passive fibre page describes the family ('high-density monitoring up to 16 TAPs in 1RU', insertion loss as low as 1.3 dB) but publishes no per-model connector count or part-number matrix, so a spec would have to invent port counts. Blocked on a model-level datasheet - the MTP, LC and BiDi variants each need their own.
